kind: isolated installed-core diagnostic; no Brave-specific acceptance

privateAquamarine.scope: nested Hyprland child only; no installed replacement

STACK-MAX.name: STACK-MAX
command:
import gi,sys
gi.require_version("Gtk","4.0")
from gi.repository import Gtk,GLib,Gdk
w=Gtk.Window(title=sys.argv[1]);w.set_default_size(320,240)
p=Gtk.CssProvider();p.load_from_string("window { background: "+sys.argv[2]+"; }")
Gtk.StyleContext.add_provider_for_display(Gdk.Display.get_default(),p,Gtk.STYLE_PROVIDER_PRIORITY_APPLICATION)
w.present();GLib.MainLoop().run()
